titulo.alumno: Asking about charges, services and nearby transport

intro: In this lesson you will practice asking about charges, services and nearby transport.

texto: Compare price, charges and location; for a breakdown, describe where it is and what needs repairing.

frases.estudio: Στην τιμή περιλαμβάνονται τα κοινόχρηστα, αλλά όχι το διαδίκτυο.
frases.alumno: The price includes community charges, but not internet.

frases.estudio: Ο νεροχύτης έχει διαρροή και ο ιδιοκτήτης θα στείλει τεχνικό αύριο.
frases.alumno: The sink has a leak and the owner will send a technician tomorrow.

frases.estudio: Το πρώτο διαμέρισμα είναι φθηνότερο, αλλά έχει μικρή κουζίνα.
frases.alumno: The first floor is cheaper, but it has a small kitchen.

pregunta.texto: Listen to the call and recognize the breakdown or the condition of the accommodation.
